SELECT
                 id                AS "id!: String",
                 name              AS "name!: String",
                 tags              AS "tags!: String",
                 owner             AS "owner?: String",
                 pinned_version_id AS "pinned_version_id?: String",
                 archived          AS "archived!: i64",
                 created_at        AS "created_at!: String"
               FROM strategy WHERE id = ?1
